name: dsh-plugin-pace-skin
description: Shared visual skin for the dsh-pace-popups suite: a no-UI plugin that injects one set of design tokens (--pp-*) and utility classes (.pp-*) into the page. Editorial 'lieflat' texture — hairline strokes, generous whitespace, ledger rails, flat surfaces, brightness-carries-hierarchy — while keeping the suite's color (discipline hues + a single gold accent). Load it once; every other popup consumes the same tokens.
